content.introduction: The Asian financial markets on Investing.com include information on Asian Stock Markets, Indices Futures, Commodities, and Financial Futures. The Nikkei 225 closed at 68,309.46, down 647.26 points (-0.94%), the Hang Seng closed at 23,972.29, down 640.98 points (-2.60%), and the S&P/ASX 200 closed at 8,682.10, up 67.70 points (+0.79%). The top gainers include Resonac Holdings, up 1385.0 points (+8.71%), and Furukawa Electric, up 316.0 points (+7.68%). The top losers include Nissan Motor, down 144.7 points (-4.97%). The sources do not provide a definitive answer for specific questions not directly asked.
